routes.name: Lost Lek
routes.desc: The leftmost route on 'Duncan's Boot', up the thin crack. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Make a Bow
routes.desc: Short, hard and reachy. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: The Dark Side
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'The Voice of Doom'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: The Voice of Doom
routes.desc: Climbs the tufas just right of 'The Dark Side'. Shares the same anchors. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Falling in Love
routes.desc: Old slings and expansion bolts. Do not climb!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old slings and expansion bolts.

routes.name: Alter Schwede!
routes.desc: Rebolted with titanium bolts. Be sure to clip the new bolts since the old stainless steel ones are still there.

routes.name: Robert's Dilemma
routes.desc: Not rebolted with titanium. 5 stainless steel glue-in bolts, 1 sling.
routes.setter: Björn Alber, Nantawan Alber, Robert Baier & Mo Baier, 2009
warnings: Fixed Gear: Not rebolted with titanium. 5 stainless steel glue-in bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Karaoke
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'Mai Prue'. New slings and titanium bolts. Be sure to clip the new bolts because the old expansion bolts and stainless steel glue-ins are still there.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Be sure to clip the new bolts because the old expansion bolts and stainless steel glue-ins are still there.

routes.name: Mai Prue / Never Mind
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'Karaoke'. Rebolted with titanium bolts. Be sure to clip the new bolts since the old stainless steel ones are still there.

routes.name: Top Knot
routes.desc: Rightmost line on 'Duncan's Boot'. Sharp rock. 3 titanium bolts, 1 sling.
